highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 previews the Skia m155 engine with current servicing fixes.
highlights_body: It also updates HarfBuzzSharp, improves GLES interop signatures, and disables unsupported RAW and DNG image decoding.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to m155 and incorporates the current upstream Chrome and servicing fixes.
Updates the native GLES interop declarations to use pointer-based signatures, matching the underlying API more accurately.
Disables unsupported RAW and DNG image decoding paths in the bundled renderer.

preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14: Preview 1 opened the 4.155 line with the Skia m155 engine update.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13: Preview 2 updated HarfBuzzSharp, refined GLES interop, and incorporated current m155 renderer fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8: The release candidate adds the latest m155 servicing fixes for final validation.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates the bundled HarfBuzzSharp native library to version 14.4.0.
